blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—The Land Transportation Franchising and Regulatory Board (LTFRB) on Friday reminded public utility vehicle (PUV) operators and drivers to honor the mandatory 20 percent fare discount for persons with disabilities (PWDs) as millions of Filipinos head to their home provinces for Undas. Violations of the discount rule carry a fine of P5,000 for the first offense, P10,000 and a six-month suspension of the operator’s Certificate of Public Convenience (CPC) for the second offense, and cancellation of the CPC for the third offense.
